summary: Apply a previewed update at its revision, optionally removing the conflicting tracks its preview listed.

title: Add an assembly variant
summary: Add an assembly variant named `name` (unique, case-insensitively), empty or, with `copy_of`, a copy of that variant's overrides.

title: List assembly variants
summary: The assembly variants, the active one, and every bought part's population and fitted Part in the default and in each variant.

title: Delete an assembly variant
summary: Delete a variant and its overrides.

title: Rename an assembly variant
summary: Rename a variant.

title: Review a variant's substitute part
summary: Record a person's review of a variant's substitute part.

title: Choose the active assembly variant
summary: Choose the variant the 3D view, BOM, pick-and-place and fabrication output follow; none (null) is the default.

title: Keep parts off the BOM or pick-and-place
summary: Keep parts off the BOM or out of the pick-and-place files, in every variant.

title: Fit another part in a variant
summary: Fit another manufacturer part on a part's footprint in one variant; null fits the default part again.

title: Set whether parts are fitted
summary: Set whether parts are fitted: in the default (no `variant`) or in one variant.

title: Parts that fit a footprint
summary: The Parts of the project library that can be fitted on a part's footprint in a variant: the same land pattern and pad grouping.

title: What the window shows
summary: What the window shows: workspace, PCB view, sheet and the selection with ids.

title: Open a workspace or view
summary: Show a workspace: the PCB in layout or 3d, a schematic sheet, or a component draft.

title: Select in the window
summary: Select and frame objects in the window by id; never the document, no undo step.

title: Draw a wire
summary: Draw a wire along a given path: from `from` through `corners` to `to`, each a target or a free end `{"free": [x, y]}`.

title: Insert a wire corner
summary: Add a corner at `at`, a point on the wire, without changing its shape.

title: Move a wire corner
summary: Move corner `index` (from 0, counted from the wire's `from` end) to `to`.

title: Move a wire end
summary: Move or re-attach the wire's `from` or `to` end, rubber-banding its path.

title: Move a wire segment
summary: Move one wire segment along its normal by `offset` mm.

title: Remove a wire corner
summary: Remove corner `index`, merging its two segments; the result may slant.

title: Remove a wire segment
summary: Remove segment `index`: the wire splits in two, with free ends at the gap.

title: Set a wire's path
summary: Replace a wire's geometry: its corners and, when given, either end (a target or a free end).

title: Round a wire corner
summary: Round corner `index` by an arc of `radius` mm tangent to both of its segments; 0 makes it sharp.
